style: Strict, does not accept any compromise or alternative evidence
Questions passage planning and UKC in great detail
Rude and arrogant, shouts at officers and crew
Checks bridge equipment thoroughly, item by item

questions.q: How do you change over between gyro 1 and 2 and cross check with ECDIS and radar?
Where is the radar performance and blind sector poster?
Are the ECDIS safety settings correct, including BCL 024?
Why did you make a PI when a drying height is present?
How do you test AIS and VHF on low power?
How do you do the GMDSS battery on/off load test?
How do you do the daily and weekly GMDSS tests?
What is the company requirement for AIS testing?
What are the BNWAS stages and alarms, and is the log entry made?
What is AIO?
How is UKC calculated in the passage plan and cross checked with the master pilot exchange?
Are the abort point and point of no return with contingency anchorage marked on ECDIS?
When was ECDIS last updated and do main and backup have the same number of ENCs?
Is the GMDSS log maintained with GMDSS watch off at berth?
Are ADP and AENP updated?
What is the company policy for non compliance with UKC during transit?
Is the magnetic compass light working?
Is the BWL 2 entry in the deck log book with lookout recorded?
Is the compass error log checked?
Is the Aldis lamp and spare bulb checked?
Is the GMDSS portable radio tested for power and what is the requirement?
What is the minimum steering speed with and without engine?

checks.item: Gyro changeover cross checked with ECDIS and radar
Radar performance and blind sector poster
AIS and VHF low power test
BNWAS stages alarm and log entry
ECDIS abort point and point of no return with contingency anchorage
ECDIS last update and ENC count on main and backup
GMDSS log with watch off at berth
BWL 2 entry in deck log book with lookout

tips: Be ready to justify any PI made when a drying height is present
Keep ECDIS main and backup ENC counts identical
Have GMDSS battery load test and daily/weekly test records ready
summary: Bridge inspection at Kandla by Capt. Pankaj Singh on 04 June 2025. He went through bridge equipment and passage planning in detail, especially UKC, ECDIS settings and GMDSS tests, and cleared the bridge with no remarks. He was strict and did not accept compromises, and was rude and arrogant, shouting at officers and crew.
